value.title: Native forwarding repair and inherited identity

sections.name: body
sections.value:
This updates the exact-snapshot limits in 2026-11-06-native-forwarding-trust-and-proof-boundaries for PR #147 head 5c8ff97a8cb021e4f862afdde137713c50658c05.

The reviewer demonstrated a real normal-inheritance identity defect: a legitimate paneless child can inherit its parent's PIJ_SESSION_ID. Do not dismiss that case merely as malicious caller environment selection. The earlier review had not established this counterexample.

The repair requires TMUX_PANE for non-help shim send forwarding, regardless of inherited seat identity. Paneless role and --to sends retain routed observed-host admission, which validates and substitutes the admitted descriptor rather than trusting the inherited sender/PID/start.

Preliminary native whoami now forwards caller_context through the existing Codex contradiction check. The context still has None PID/start: full available context is not immutable process attestation or universal native/routed equivalence.

Value flags and equals forms are consumed before classification; -- ends option scanning. Literal --help after --, or --help used as a value, cannot become the help shortcut around the pane gate. Those two combinations were source-assessed, not locally executed.

The resolver now excludes empty/relative PATH entries, checks file/X_OK and spawns an absolute selected pathname without a second search. This is not ownership/version/signature pinning or symlink/replacement-race protection. Absolute directories, including normalized .. paths or repository locations, remain caller trust.

CI run 42197742059 has 1978 passing JUnit cases, six shim tests and three clap contracts. Inherited-parent fixtures show non-forwarding; descriptor substitution/refusal uses mocked admission. No new combined real-parent/child attribution-and-parent-binding regression was demonstrated. Production/test content matches CI, but whole trees differ by fourteen documentation lines.

No local execution was performed. Full delta verdict: .harness/government/community/roles/security/outputs/2026-11-06-pr-147-5c8ff97-security.md.
